conclusions: Absolute-band dispatch supports all five tiers; bands are disjoint. The pre-replay tests cover AVERAGE/GREAT and UNKNOWN; a direct all-five dispatch audit is recorded in artifact_audit.log.
80% faithful coarse sensor mixes neighboring latent states; conditional cell EV is not individual latent EV.
Middle bands have half-width .002. Diagnostic radius and window bias dominate when center lies near boundaries.
All samples are date clustered: 24 stocks are not 24 independent dates. Prior recent calibration has at most 21 dates.
Global quarantine and signal-identifiability gates additionally suppress coverage; counters isolate these from interval rejection.
Original manager delegates quality to caller conditional_ev; causal ledger handles outcome availability, not inference validity.
Short recent cell windows confound estimation and calibration; date-common noise forbids stock count as independent N.
Frozen partial pooling uses neighboring cells only from training; independent block residuals calibrate uncertainty without fitting mean.
Five-date blocks address short date correlation but reduce effective sample. Missing cell dates reduce support further.
No holdout online fit or residual bias fit: safety latches independently, never narrows intervals.
No observable precursors to reversal in DGP; pre-maturation protection is information-limited.
Original manager accepts caller conditional_ev; it does not provide a class estimator. Prior causal ledger certifies timestamps, not calibration.

limitations: Synthetic regression tapes previously evaluated in iteration2: untouched means no fit/update with holdout outcomes in iteration3, not fresh confirmatory data.
Five-date block independence and approximately Gaussian date-block means assumed; finite sample robust coverage is not guaranteed.
Posterior is over conditional mean bands, not individual latent class; no oracle labels in fit.

Synthetic sensor information is injected; no real-market alpha claim.
One-session net labels differ from multi-session portfolio holdings; no terminal liquidation.
holdout_policy: No holdout outcome changes fit, calibration or posterior. Strictly matured holdout contrasts may only latch UNKNOWN. Tapes were viewed in iteration2; not fresh confirmatory holdout.

fundamental_diagnosis: Stable synthetic sensor contains predictive information by construction; failure to certify middle bands with 78/42 dates and block uncertainty is finite-information limitation, not proof of no signal. Null lacks PIT association by construction. Reversal has no observable advance warning: before matured outcomes no causal detector can distinguish it. Real PIT predictive information remains untested; no real-market edge inferred. Stable middle radii .00236..00508 exceed .002 half-band: all middle support remains zero, so five-way monotonicity fails on every seed. Stable coverage rises by 13.03 percentage points through extreme classes only. Stable nuisance alarms decline from 15 to 1 across four seeds, but permanent latching sacrifices adaptation. At reversal, stronger frozen extreme assignments cause 102 false GREAT before the seven-session alarm versus23 online comparator; pre-alarm wrong assignments explain zero reversal conditional accuracy. This separates stationary finite-information limits from unavoidable delayed regime evidence; it does not establish that predictive information is universally absent.
